settings.companySettingsManagerOnlyHint: Only owners and admins can edit company settings.

help.title: Help & FAQ
help.subtitle: Answers to common questions about working with Cantero, grouped by topic.
help.noResults: No matching questions. Try a different search term.
help.gettingStarted_q1_q: How do I create my first project?
help.gettingStarted_q1_a: Go to Projects in the sidebar, fill in a name and optional address, and click Create. You can link it to a client right away or add one later.
help.gettingStarted_q2_q: How do I add a client?
help.gettingStarted_q2_a: Open Clients from the sidebar and create a new client record — you can then link projects, estimates, and invoices to them.
help.gettingStarted_q3_q: What's the difference between metric and imperial units?
help.gettingStarted_q3_a: Your company's unit system is set once (in Company settings) and applies to every rate catalog item and material quantity across the app.
help.gettingStarted_q4_q: How do I invite a teammate?
help.gettingStarted_q4_a: Go to Settings → Team members and send an invite by email. They'll choose a role (owner, admin, estimator, foreman, accountant, or worker) that controls what they can see and do.
help.estimates_q1_q: How do I build an estimate?
help.estimates_q1_a: Open a project, click New estimate, then add sections and lines by picking items from your rate catalog and entering quantities — cost and markup recalculate automatically.
help.estimates_q2_q: How does approving an estimate generate a material list?
help.estimates_q2_a: Approving an estimate rolls up every material used across its lines into a read-only requirement list, so you know exactly what to order.
help.estimates_q3_a: An assembly bundles several rate-catalog items together (e.g. "install a door" = door + hardware + labor) so you can add one line instead of five.
help.estimates_q4_a: Upload a plan or photo, calibrate it against a known real-world length, then trace lengths and areas on the drawing to pull quantities straight into an estimate.
help.estimates_q5_a: The estimate accuracy tool compares an estimate's cost per rate item against your actual job-costing history, so you can see which items you consistently under- or over-price.
help.projects_q1_q: How do I track tasks and schedule?
help.projects_q1_a: Each project has a task board (planned/in progress/done) and a timeline view. Add start and due dates to see a task on the timeline, and link tasks with dependencies to auto-shift dates.
help.projects_q2_a: One entry per project per calendar date — weather, crew on site, work performed, and any delays — the standard site-diary format.
help.projects_q3_q: How does the punch list work?
help.projects_q3_a: Log outstanding items with a location and photo as you walk the site; each one is tracked open or closed so nothing gets missed before handover.
help.projects_q4_q: Can I restrict who sees a project?
help.projects_q4_a: Yes — turn on "Restrict to specific team members" in a project's access settings. Owners and admins can always see every project regardless.
help.materials_q1_q: How do I track stock levels?
help.materials_q1_a: Warehouses hold a stock level per material. Every receipt, issue, transfer, or write-off is a logged movement, so on-hand quantity is always derived from real history, not manually edited.
help.materials_q2_a: Set a reorder threshold on a material catalog item — once on-hand quantity drops below it, it shows up in your notifications.
help.materials_q3_q: How do I order from a supplier?
help.materials_q3_a: Create a purchase order against a supplier, add lines, and mark it received once the delivery arrives — receiving auto-updates stock levels.
help.materials_q4_q: How do I compare quotes from several suppliers?
help.materials_q4_a: Use a Material RFQ: invite suppliers, record what each one quoted per line, and award the winning quote per line — the cheapest supplier can differ by material.
help.finance_q1_q: How do I invoice a client?
help.finance_q1_a: Generate an invoice straight from an approved estimate (progress or full amount), or from a recurring invoice schedule for retainer-style billing.
help.finance_q2_a: A schedule-of-values progress-billing format tied to job costing, so each invoice shows percent complete per cost code the way construction lenders and owners expect.
help.finance_q3_a: Set a frequency (weekly, monthly, quarterly, yearly), a start date, and lines — Cantero generates and sends each occurrence automatically until the end date or you turn it off.
help.finance_q4_a: Import your bank statement and match each transaction against invoices and expenses — anything left unmatched is flagged for review.
help.finance_q5_a: It packages an invoice plus the supporting documentation a construction lender expects, tracked through submitted / under review / approved / funded.
help.subcontractors_q1_a: A subcontractor can't be assigned to a project without current general liability and workers' comp insurance on file — Cantero blocks the assignment and tells you what's missing or expired.
help.subcontractors_q2_q: How do I rate a subcontractor's performance?
help.subcontractors_q2_a: After an assignment, log a performance review (rating, on-time, would-hire-again, safety incidents, rework) — the scorecard rolls these up automatically.
help.subcontractors_q3_a: A signed document a subcontractor provides in exchange for payment, waiving their right to file a lien for that amount. Cantero can auto-request one when you mark a cost paid.
help.subcontractors_q4_a: For US companies: fill in a subcontractor's tax ID and legal name under their tax profile, record payments as they happen, and the 1099 summary shows each subcontractor's total paid for the year and flags who crosses the $600 threshold.
help.team_q1_q: How do I add a worker?
help.team_q1_a: Go to Team → New team member. A worker doesn't need a full user login to be tracked — phone-only workers can still receive SMS notifications and be assigned to tasks.
help.team_q2_a: Each worker has an hourly cost rate; logged time entries against a project multiply hours by that rate to feed budget-vs-actual.
help.team_q3_q: What's the geofence check for time entries?
help.team_q3_a: Set a project's site coordinates and radius, and clock-ins from the field app outside that radius get flagged for review — the entry still succeeds, it's just marked for a second look.
help.team_q4_a: For public-works projects with prevailing-wage rules, a weekly WH-347-style report per worker, checked against the wage classifications you define.
help.safety_q1_q: How do I log a safety incident?
help.safety_q1_a: Use "Quick near-miss" for a fast, low-friction report, or "New incident" for anything requiring OSHA recordability details, involved persons, and corrective actions.
help.safety_q2_a: A proactive checklist for hazardous work — task description, hazards, control measures, and required PPE — that crew members acknowledge before starting.
help.safety_q3_a: Log a topic, date, and notes, and mark which workers attended — a record of the safety conversation, distinct from a JHA's structured hazard/control format.
help.safety_q4_a: Run an inspection from a reusable checklist template per trade, and log any deficiencies found with a location, photo, and the worker responsible for fixing them.
help.documents_q1_a: The Documents panel on a project accepts contracts, permits, photos, invoice scans, and more — each has a category, optional tags, and a full version history.
help.documents_q2_q: How do I track a building permit?
help.documents_q2_a: Log the permit type, number, and issuing authority on a project, move it through draft → submitted → approved, and schedule the municipal inspections tied to it.
help.documents_q3_q: Can I reuse a document as a template?
help.documents_q3_a: Yes — the Templates section holds reusable checklists and default text for RFIs, safety briefings, and punch lists so you're not typing the same thing every time.
help.settings_q1_q: How do I change the interface language?
help.settings_q1_a: Open the language switcher (EN / DE / ES / PL / UK) — it changes what you see immediately; SMS notifications to workers use their own preferred-language setting instead.
help.settings_q2_q: How do I set up single sign-on?
help.settings_q2_a: Under Settings → SSO, configure your identity provider so teammates can sign in with company credentials instead of a Cantero password.
help.settings_q3_q: How do I export the audit log?
help.settings_q3_a: Settings → Audit log lets owners and admins filter by date, action, or actor and export the result as a CSV.
help.settings_q4_q: Can I limit which team members see a specific feature?
help.settings_q4_a: Custom roles let you define exactly which parts of the app a role can see and act on, beyond the built-in owner/admin/estimator/foreman/accountant/worker roles.
